subject: Mid-contract uplift: capacity & pricing options
messages:
From: Sarah Lim <sarah.lim@luminahealth.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-18T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Request: mid-contract capacity uplift and pricing alignment

Jordan —

We're seeing a faster-than-expected ramp in our pilot (Q3) and need to discuss a mid-contract uplift. Usage jumped ~28% week-over-week and we'll need additional dedicated capacity next 90 days to avoid throttling. Can you outline: 1) a quick top-up path (non-committed) that we can start immediately, and 2) a co-term / staged commit option if we want to lock in better unit economics. 

Can you share a one-page summary and a ballpark for discounts applied to generation vs embeddings? I'm looping in procurement (procurement@luminahealth.com) — they'll want an amendment template and PO flow if we proceed.

I've attached a trimmed usage export (usage_report_Q3.csv) to give a sense of hourly spikes.

Thanks,
Sarah
Sarah Lim
Head of Platform, Lumina Health
sarah.lim@luminahealth.com

Attachment: usage_report_Q3.csv (CSV, 48KB)

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Lim <sarah.lim@luminahealth.com>
Cc: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>, Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-18T14:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: mid-contract capacity uplift and pricing alignment

Sarah —

Thanks for the heads up and the file. Short answer: we can do both paths. Attached is a quick worksheet with two starter scenarios (preliminary_pricing_worksheet.xlsx).

High level:
• Option 1 — Rapid top-up: immediate capacity add on your current rates + 5% uplift fee; no term change, instant activation. Good if you need capacity today.
• Option 2 — Staged commit (co-term): 3–6 month staged commit with a blended discount (larger discount the more committed). Example: +20% committed run-rate → ~10% blended discount on gen tokens, embeddings stay at baseline unless bundled.

Can you confirm expected sustained run-rate (tokens/day) for the next 60–90 days? That will let us firm numbers. I'm looping in Naomi (pricing lead) and Mateo (platform ops) to scope capacity.

We can turn an amendment into DocuSign if Procurement prefers.

—Jordan
Jordan Blake
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.com

Attachment: preliminary_pricing_worksheet.xlsx (XLSX, 22KB)

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-19T10:22:00-07:00
Subject: Internal: Lumina uplift — discount sensitivity

Jordan/Mateo —

Quick internal note before we lock numbers for Sarah:
• We should protect margin on embeddings — high volume embedding usage can erode discounts quickly. Consider gating embeddings discount to blended-commit only.
• Pricing trade-offs: 1) nominal top-up fee (5–8%) for on-demand; 2) staged commit (min 3 months overlap) gets 8–12% off gen tokens depending on uplift band; include a 30–60 day true-up window.
• Recommendation: offer a limited 14-day window for the co-term proposal to encourage decision. If they opt-in, we can extend a one-time invoice credit up to 10% for migration overhead.

Naomi
Naomi Feldman
Director, Pricing
naomi.feldman@redwood.com

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Lim <sarah.lim@luminahealth.com>
Cc: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>, Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-20T08:40:00-07:00
Subject: Proposal: two uplift paths (options + amendment link)

Sarah —

Appended a concise proposal and next steps (see Lumina_midterm_proposal_v1.pdf attached). Two concrete options below — these are binding only after signatures.

Option A — Fast top-up (immediate):
• Action: Add dedicated capacity pool equal to estimated 30% uplift. Activation within 48 hours.
• Pricing: current unit rates + 6% activation fee (one-time). No change to contract term.
• Discount: none on embeddings; generation tokens billed at existing committed rate.

Option B — Staged co-term commit (preferred for economics):
• Action: 3-month staged commit that co-terms with current contract. Commit size: +20% run-rate.
• Pricing: blended 12% discount on generation tokens over commit period; embeddings billed at standard rate unless a +40% uplift triggers a bundled embedding discount.
• True-up: 60-day true-up after staging window. DocuSign amendment to be used.

Next steps:
1) Confirm which option (A or B) you prefer and expected run-rate (tokens/day).
2) If Option B, Procurement provides PO/contract contact and we'll issue amendment via DocuSign: https://docusign.com/envelopes/0a1b2c3d
3) Mateo will schedule capacity provisioning contingent on signed amendment.

I've CC'd Marissa from Legal to help with amendment language and procurement flow.

Thanks — can we schedule a short call tomorrow if useful?

—Jordan
Attachment: Lumina_midterm_proposal_v1.pdf (PDF, 65KB)
Related: https://hubspot.com/contacts/HS-96722

From: Sarah Lim <sarah.lim@luminahealth.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@luminahealth.com
Date: 2026-09-20T17:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Proposal: two uplift paths (options + amendment link)

Jordan —

Thanks for the clear options. Quick clarifying questions before we loop Procurement formally:
1) Does the 12% blended discount in Option B apply to embeddings if we hit the +20% uplift threshold, or do embeddings require the +40% band? Our data team is embedding-heavy this month.
2) For Option A, what is the expected activation timeline and do you have an interim SLA for the first 72 hours? We need to avoid token errors during peak clinical hours.

Procurement has attached a PO template (PO_Template.docx). I'll connect Kevin Liu from Procurement (kevin.liu@luminahealth.com) if we move forward.

Appreciate the quick turnaround.

—Sarah

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Lim <sarah.lim@luminahealth.com>, procurement@luminahealth.com
Cc: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-21T09:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Proposal: two uplift paths (options + amendment link)

Sarah/Kevin —

Answers inline:
1) Embeddings: default is to keep embeddings at baseline pricing. We can fold embeddings into the Option B blended discount only if they commit +40% uplift (or add a small fixed surcharge to embed volume). If embeddings are central, we can draft a custom bundle — Naomi will model that.
2) Activation SLA for Option A: provisioning within 48 hours; operational monitoring and increased support coverage for first 72 hours. Mateo will kick off the provisioning and set up a temporary alerting channel.

Please confirm the PO contact and whether Procurement wants the amendment via DocuSign (link in prior email). If you're ready, we'll issue the amendment and queue capacity.

Happy to schedule a 20-minute call to go through the proposal — suggest 10:30 AM PT tomorrow.

—Jordan
Jordan Blake
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.com
Attachments referenced: PO_Template.docx
